    • insertInstruction

      public void insertInstruction(int pos, AVM2Instruction instruction)
      Inserts instruction at specified point. Handles offsets properly. Note: If newinstruction is jump, the offset operand must be handled properly by caller. All old jump offsets to pos are targeted before new instruction.
      Parameters:
      pos - Position in the list
      instruction - Instruction False means before new instruction

    • insertInstruction

      public void insertInstruction(int pos, AVM2Instruction instruction, boolean mapOffsetsAfterIns)
      Inserts instruction at specified point. Handles offsets properly. Note: If newinstruction is jump, the offset operand must be handled properly by caller.
      Parameters:
      pos - Position in the list
      instruction - Instruction
      mapOffsetsAfterIns - Map all jumps to the pos after new instruction? False means before new instruction
